title: triage-bullet-journal-aisha
body:
2026-03-13 - morning sweep
---
09:10 quick notes:
- Customer ACME reported dashboard "live-updates" lagging ~8-12s on counts panel. Repro w/ their tenant (region: us-west-2).
- Observed increased CPU on realtime-ingest pod + spikes in kv-cache misses.
- Short-term workaround: ask customer to toggle Realtime=false on dashboard settings. That drops lag to ~1s.
- Related incident: INC-1234 (customer-reported). Linked above.

Triage steps taken:
- 09:18 checked SLOs: latency spikes correspond to batch flushes at 09:15 (see logs).
- 09:25 kubectl: kubectl logs -n obs realtime-ingest-5f7 --since=20m | grep flush -> multiple flush cycles overlapping spooler window.
- 09:30 validated cache stats from /metrics -> kv_cache_misses jumped 4x around flush.
- 09:40 rolled a canary config: reduced prefix batch window from 200ms -> 80ms for tenant acme-01.
- 09:55 monitor: latency dropped to baseline for that tenant. Confirmed with customer.

Open action items (priority ordered):
- [ ] Follow up w/ Alex: add a unit/regression test for overlapping spooler windows (INFR-4526). Link PR once ready.
- [x] Notify CS about workaround and ask ACME to toggle Realtime if they see lag again (done at 10:05).
- [ ] Add a dashboard alert for kv_cache_miss_rate > 2.5x baseline for >2m (owner: Priya).
- [ ] Postmortem stub: capture root cause (race between batch flush scheduler and KV eviction). Draft outline in Confluence page (TODO link).
- [ ] Consider a bounded jitter on flush schedule to avoid synchronized flush waves across pods.

Notes to self / heuristics:
- If multiple tenants see same pattern within a 10m window, suspect global spooler config or a recent rollout.
- Quick debug sequence: check spooler logs -> check metrics (kv_cache, tokenization times) -> canary small batch window -> observe for 30m -> revert if unstable.

Unresolved questions:
- Is there a recent infra rollout on us-west-2 around 09:00? Check release-engineering channel and deployment tags.
- Does Dedicated customers routing differ for ACME that would surface different batch sizes? Need SRE input.

References / handy links:
- Jira: INFR-4526 (perf test + regression)
- Slack thread: #observability (thread ts: 16802XXXX)
- PR draft: github.com/redwood/console/pull/789 (WIP, Alex)

End of morning log.
Quick TL;DR to paste in incident: "Root cause appears to be synchronized batch flushes causing KV cache thrashing for ACME tenant. Short-term config tweak reduced latency. Follow-ups: add alert, regression test, postmortem."
